The '''''Violet Hem''''' was a space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] that was owned by an unidentified [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who started a company making communications equipment. He and his advisers preferred to live on the ''Violet Hem'', which was a reference to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] robes. The ''Violet Hem'' was destroyed when [[Dia Passik]], the yacht owner's [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], deactivated the yacht's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] before stealing an armed [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and destroying the ''Violet Hem''.<ref name="IF">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
